title: M4 B5 exact-view repeatability screen
research_question: For the same 24 fixed M4 contexts, do Public-only versus Privileged-original majority-label differences exceed within-view label variation across identical repeated requests?
hypothesis: Across the 24 fixed contexts, when each view is repeated three times with byte-identical requests, the Public-only versus Privileged-original unique-mode difference will occur in more contexts than within-view output disagreement.
selection_rationale: The already completed 232-call campaign varied evidence views but had one request per view/context, while a separate exact-request audit found 19/48 raw-label disagreements across historical/current observations. The prior 464-call proposal also included a distinct 320-call synthetic prompt/schema-order factorial. This candidate retains only the direct repeated-view validity question and defers the factorial until repeatability is characterized.
competing_explanations: The historical view differences are mostly within-view output variation and do not recur as stable view-majority differences.
A stable difference recurs, but it is caused by the bundled evidence package (permissions, event structure, metadata, wording, and token length), not message semantics.
A mutable provider alias, hidden serving-state changes, or reported-fingerprint drift accounts for differences across requests.
Request compilation or serialization changes among nominal repeats, so the intended exact-input comparison was not implemented.

prior_evidence.claim: The 232-call context-sensitivity campaign was completed and independently replayed; A1 labels changed 12/24 Public-only to Neutral, 20/24 Neutral to Original, and 19/24 Public-only to Original, with an inconclusive decision.
The raw-response audit found 19/48 historical/current raw label disagreements for exact request bodies and matching reported fingerprints; the cause is not identified.

protocol.sample_selection: All 24 contexts in the frozen A1 intersection from the completed M4 B5 campaign; select by the existing hash-only A1 schedule and retain every context. Assign Public-only and Privileged-original views, three repetitions per context/view, for 144 total slots. No response- or label-based selection.
protocol.intervention: Within each context/view, issue three identical request bodies. Randomize all 144 assignments with the hash-only frozen schedule seed 20261022. Compare Public-only to Privileged-original only; defer the synthetic prompt/schema order factorial and the Neutral arm.
held_constant: The 24 selected contexts, B5 system prompt, task, tool schema, request compiler, sampling settings, and exact request-body bytes across the three repetitions within each context/view.
DeepSeek Flash alias, temperature 0, thinking disabled, maximum output 512, and forced report_evidence tool contract, subject to pre-registration identity recheck.
No researcher-only case ID, treatment label, reference, repeat index, or schedule identifier is included in model-visible requests.
protocol.primary_outcome: For each view/context, three raw labels, unique-mode status, unanimity, and within-view pairwise disagreements; for every context with a unique mode in both views, the Public-only versus Privileged-original unique-mode transition. Report invalid/malformed, failed, and unstarted slots separately.
protocol.denominator: 24 fixed contexts; 48 context-view cells; 144 assigned physical attempts. All assignments remain in the denominator; no retry or replacement.
protocol.success_gate: Stable package difference observed if at least 18/24 contexts have a unique mode in both views and cross-view mode changes are at least 6 and exceed the count of contexts with any within-view disagreement. This is a fixed-corpus descriptive gate only.
protocol.failure_gate: Historical contrast not reproduced if at least 18/24 contexts have a unique mode in both views, at most 1/24 cross-view mode changes, and at most 6/24 contexts have any within-view disagreement. This does not establish general invariance.
protocol.ambiguous_gate: Inconclusive for all other outcome patterns, including fewer than 18 contexts with unique modes in both views or cross-view changes that do not exceed within-view instability. Any model/endpoint identity drift or request-byte mismatch invalidates the intended repeatability contrast; stop and retain all assigned rows and failures.
protocol.failure_policy: Zero retries and zero replacements. Every attempt is durably ledgered before transport. Invalid output, timeout, HTTP error, interruption, or unstarted slot remains recorded and is never repaired or resampled.
protocol.reproduction_command: Offline preparation: python scripts/freeze_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py ; python scripts/run_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py --prepare. Offline fake-server canary: python -m pytest -q tests/test_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py. Dispatch command after final registration and separate explicit approval only: python scripts/run_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py --dispatch; production dispatch fails closed unless authorization, preregistration, manifest, runtime hashes, time window, and endpoint checks pass.
protocol.runtime_identity: Candidate: official DeepSeek endpoint and deepseek-flash alias, historically listed as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on 2026-10-21. The alias is mutable; recheck official version, exact pricing, and off-peak schedule immediately before registration and every dispatch window. Temperature 0, thinking disabled, max output 512, strict report_evidence tool. Provider token usage is recorded per response; the 12,104 figure is a conservative preflight input-token bound, not tokenizer output.
protocol.private_data_boundary: Privileged-original requests contain the two historical private-message events for each context. Across 72 privileged requests this is 144 event appearances sent to the provider; explicit scope-specific user approval is required. Raw request/response content remains local in a restricted Git-ignored directory.
protocol.analysis_plan: Use context as the paired unit. Do not treat three repeats or their pairwise combinations as independent samples. Do not calculate significance tests or population estimates. Public-harm deterministic references are a separate rule baseline; neither the reference nor treatment/collusion metadata enters model prompts. No collusion or intent label is created.

authorization.scope: Not authorized. A new explicit approval must name m4-b5-view-repeatability-v2, at most 144 physical attempts and USD 0.35, official DeepSeek Flash only, off-peak only, zero retries/replacements, an expiry, and external transmission of 144 private-message event appearances.
